training.controller: unchanged native policy and unweighted raw depth residual inputs
training.effect_scope: local weighting plus native controller response, not identical realized lambda_V trajectories

local_weight.input: absolute difference of frozen prior and DA3 camera-Z targets at the same raster index under inherited calibration
local_weight.raster_convention_caveat: prior Open3D u+.5/v+.5 versus DA3 integer u/v unprojection; strict identical subpixel rays not established; inherited input bytes retained
local_weight.threshold_policy: shared fixed meter-scale exploratory ramp; prospective choice from input-only audit; not calibrated correctness/noise thresholds
local_weight.decision_basis: test explicit meter-scale local release hypothesis; Q50/Q90 suppresses visual supervision for discrepancies of several meters; do not tune to GT/results
local_weight.sampling: deterministic uniformly spaced valid flattened indices; equally subsample each region to common count
local_weight.validity: finite strictly positive target; preserve native finite prediction validity in loss
local_weight.missing_source: single available source has local multiplier one; neither available has zero depth loss
local_weight.reduction: native source valid pixel count, never sum of local weights
local_weight.interpretation: discrepancy-based allocation policy; not probability of correct image depth

runtime.finish_policy: user authorized completion without morning deadline

evaluation.roi_policy: exact parent Anchor raw512 bounds, reference membership/CRS provenance reused; no new GT-driven crop
evaluation.source_ox_scope: prior proximity and strict DA3 target world-Z residual proxies; raw photograph observability and temporal truth unclassified unless directly reviewed
evaluation.reference_missingness: prediction absence is failure where reference exists; unsupported reference domains unassessed
evaluation.mesh_role: raw TSDF primary and postprocessed secondary, same resolution as existing anchor/final512 comparisons
causal_limitations: one run per condition, no small-difference reproducibility claim
prior-DA3 discrepancy does not identify correct source
